Class NativeBluetoothLe

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeBluetoothLe
All Implemented Interfaces:
BluetoothLe
public final class NativeBluetoothLe extends Object implements BluetoothLe
The board's BluetoothLe: the only instance, shared by every board facade's getBluetoothLe(). Each method is a BLE intrinsic the compiler lowers to the core's BLE central, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM. Mock BluetoothLe instead.

    • connect

      public int connect(String serviceUuid, String characteristicUuid, int timeoutMillis, byte[] advertisement, int capacity)
      Description copied from interface: BluetoothLe
      Scans for the first device advertising serviceUuid, connects to it, and subscribes to notifications on characteristicUuid. Waits at most timeoutMillis, or indefinitely when it is zero or negative. Copies up to capacity bytes of the device's manufacturer data into advertisement.
      Specified by:
      connect in interface BluetoothLe
      Returns:
      the manufacturer data's length, once connected; -1 when no device connected in time

    • read

      public int read(byte[] buffer, int capacity)
      Description copied from interface: BluetoothLe
      Copies the next notification from the connected device into buffer, up to capacity bytes, and returns its length. Returns 0 when no notification is waiting; a notification is never empty.
      Specified by:
